title: How to Explore Your Career Options
description:
In this @teal_hq class, we're going to talk about how to explore your career options, and how to bring together things like your skills, your interests, your values, your vision, and use that to explore career options. 

What we’ll cover: 

1. Teal’s approach to thinking about career exploration.
2. Once you’ve expanded your idea of possibilities for careers, we’ll talk about how to narrow that down and how to bring some rigor into the selection process
3. We’ll audit your experience. A lot of times, if you're in the midst of a career shift or a career pivot, you might say, “I don't have the experience”—so we’ll talk about how to go and catalog all the things you've done so that you can then repackage it and present it for the role that you want to do.

00:00 | Introduction
00:55 | Teal’s approach to the career exploration process
04:10 | How to narrow down your possibilities for careers (think like a designer)
12:20 | Auditing your experience - cataloging all the things you've done 
19:43 | Repackaging your experience and presenting it for the role you want
30:10 | Wrapping & conclusion


For more on exploring your career options, and to start bookmarking jobs you're interested in, visit www.tealhq.com.
